meta.title: YouTube Video Chapter Marker
meta.description: Create YouTube description chapter lists (00:00:00 Title) with frame-accurate seeking, VFR frame mapping, and background scene detection.

loading.analyzingHeading: Analyzing video metadata and building frame map
loading.threeSecRulePrefix: Analysis taking over 3 seconds automatically moves to the background so you can start editing analyzed sections immediately (
loading.introHeading: Create & Edit Frame-Accurate YouTube Chapters from Local or YouTube Videos
loading.introDescPrefix: Load a local video file or YouTube URL to seek and mark frames with precision. Import existing chapters from YouTube descriptions and export clean YouTube chapter text (
loading.dropzoneHeading: Drag & drop a video file here, or click to browse
loading.dropzoneSub: Supports MP4 · MOV · WebM · MKV · M4V and other local videos (processed locally in your browser; files are never uploaded)
loading.youtubeSectionSub: Play videos and fetch chapter lists from descriptions
loading.youtubeAutoImportLabel: Automatically import description chapters into markers & titles
loading.youtubeInvalidUrlHint: Enter a valid YouTube URL or 11-character video ID
loading.step1Desc: Parses container metadata and frame intervals to lock timestamps to exact frames—even on VFR videos.
loading.step2Desc: Automatically extracts internal scene cuts from visual and audio shifts as a separate reference axis.
loading.step3Desc: Supports Type A (titles only) and Type B (timestamped) import/export with drag-and-drop timeline matching.
loading.sampleDesc: No video file on hand? Generate a 15-second, 5-scene test video with audio chimes right in your browser to try the full workflow.

scenes.separationNotice: Reference seek points auto-detected from visual and audio shifts. Click to jump to that frame (completely separate from your markers and never included in chapter export).
scenes.emptyYouTubeTitle: Auto scene detection isn't available for YouTube videos
scenes.emptyYouTubeDesc: Browser security restrictions block direct access to video frames and audio waveforms on embedded YouTube players, so auto scene detection works only with local video files. Chapters loaded from the description can be edited in the "Markers & Chapters" tab.
scenes.emptyLocalDesc: Analyzing frame differences and audio energy shifts in the background. Detected scenes will appear here.
